instruction: A single wedge of triple-layer cake sculpted in soft modeling clay, with visible thumb-smoothed sponge layers, a squished pink cream filling, and a drippy chocolate top. A fingerprinted cherry perches on the frosting, and every surface has the matte, slightly dented charm of stop-motion clay.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Layer Cake Slice in a claymation style. A single wedge of triple-layer cake sculpted in soft modeling clay, with visible thumb-smoothed sponge layers, a squished pink cream filling, and a drippy chocolate top. A fingerprinted cherry perches on the frosting, and every surface has the matte, slightly dented charm of stop-motion clay. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
